units.source_text: 话说从前某一朝天皇时代，后宫妃嫔甚多，其中有一更衣[\[1\]](#part1330.html#m1)，

en.t: In a certain emperor's reign long ago, there were many consorts and ladies in the inner palace, and among them was one lady of the wardrobe,

units.source_text: 出身并不十分高贵，却蒙皇上特别宠爱。

en.t: whose birth was not especially noble, yet who received the emperor's particular favor.

units.source_text: 有几个出身高贵的妃子，一进宫就自命不凡，以为恩宠一定在我；

en.t: Several consorts of high birth had entered the palace thinking highly of themselves, certain that the emperor's favor would surely be theirs;

units.source_text: 如今看见这更衣走了红运，便诽谤她，妒忌她。

en.t: now, seeing this lady of the wardrobe blessed with such fortune, they slandered her and envied her.

units.source_text: 和她同等地位的，或者出身比她低微的更衣，

en.t: The ladies of the wardrobe who held the same rank as she did, or whose origins were lower than hers,

units.source_text: 自知无法竞争，更是怨恨满腹。

en.t: knew they could not compete with her, and were even more filled with resentment.

units.source_text: 这更衣朝朝夜夜侍候皇上，别的妃子看了妒火中烧。

en.t: This lady attended the emperor morning and night, and the other consorts burned with jealousy when they saw it.

units.source_text: 大约是众怨积集所致吧，这更衣生起病来，心情郁结，常回娘家休养。

en.t: Perhaps because so much resentment had gathered against her, the lady fell ill, grew depressed, and often returned to her family home to recuperate.

units.source_text: 皇上越发舍不得她，越发怜爱她，竟不顾众口非难，一味徇情，

en.t: The emperor became still more unwilling to part from her and loved her all the more tenderly, until he ignored everyone's criticism and yielded only to his feelings,

units.source_text: 此等专宠，必将成为后世话柄。

en.t: and such exclusive favor was bound to become a subject of talk in later generations.

units.source_text: 连朝中高官贵族，也都不以为然，大家侧目而视，相与议论道：

en.t: Even the high officials and nobles at court disapproved; they looked askance and said to one another:

units.source_text: 唐朝就为了有此等事，弄得天下大乱。”

en.t: The Tang dynasty was thrown into chaos precisely because of such things."

units.source_text: 这消息渐渐传遍全国，民间怨声载道，认为此乃十分可忧之事，

en.t: The news gradually spread throughout the country, and complaints filled the common people, who thought this a deeply troubling matter,

units.source_text: 将来难免闯出杨贵妃那样的滔天大祸来呢。

en.t: fearing that in time it would surely bring about a great disaster like that of Yang Guifei.

units.source_text: 更衣处此境遇，痛苦不堪，全赖主上深恩加被，战战兢兢地在宫中度日。

en.t: Placed in these circumstances, the lady of the wardrobe suffered unbearably, and only by relying on His Majesty's deep favor did she pass her days in the palace with trembling caution.
